author: Live Chat By IMsupporting

sections.description:
Hybrid AI Live Chat – HybriChat

Transform your customer support with HybriChat, our advanced AI Hybrid Live Chat solution powered by IMsupporting.com. Seamlessly blend the efficiency of AI automation with the personal touch of human Live Chat Agents.

  • AI Hybrid Technology: Let our AI handle common queries instantly, while complex issues are smoothly transferred to your human agents.
  • Live Chat Agents: Empower your team with a powerful dashboard to manage real-time conversations, transfer chats, and monitor visitor activity.
  • Instant Installation: Get started in minutes. Simply install the plugin, create a free account, and start chatting.
  • Real-time Visitor Monitoring: Watch visitors on your site in real-time, see what pages they are viewing, and proactively engage them.
  • Mobile Friendly: Fully responsive design ensures you can chat with customers on any device – desktop, tablet, or mobile.

Key Features:

  • AI & Human Synergy: The perfect balance of automation and human support.
  • Real-time Analytics: Track visitor behavior and chat performance.
  • Secure & Reliable: SSL encryption and 99.9% uptime.
  • Customizable Widget: Match the chat window to your brand’s look and feel.
  • Proactive Chat: Invite visitors to chat automatically based on their behavior.
  • Offline Messaging: Capture leads even when your team is offline.

Get started today with HybriChat and elevate your customer service experience!

For more information, visit IMsupporting.com.
sections.installation:
Adding HybriChat to your WordPress site is easy:

  1. Install the plugin from the WordPress directory and activate it.
  2. Go to Settings > IMsupporting Chat in your WordPress admin.
  3. Create a free account or enter your existing Site ID.
  4. Customize your chat widget settings.
  5. Start chatting!

You will need a free Account ID, which can be found in your welcome email or by contacting our support team.
sections.faq:
Can I use AI features with the free plan?

Yes, basic AI features are included. Advanced AI capabilities may require a premium plan.

Can I customize the chat widget?

Absolutely! You can change colors, text, and position to match your website’s design.

Is it mobile friendly?

Yes, both the chat widget for visitors and the operator dashboard are fully responsive.
